milestone.title: Native Rust geometric intelligence — conversation, memory, reasoning and coding
milestone.description:
Build useful local geometric intelligence in Rust: preparation, learning, artifacts and inference. Prime/ordered-n-let addresses, fixed zeta phases, R4/S3/H4 state, exact Z[phi]/orientation, typed paired-H4/icosian geometry and UOR identity remain primary. Offline Rust training may use matrix multiplication; serving uses learned bounded geometric routing/state and integer/table operators, with no hidden dense transformer or response provider.

Immediate owner-adopted sequence (2026-09-05): #1137 role-aware shared source selection/commit -> #1138 learned exact relations beyond the raw window -> #1139 selective geometric access at complete cost -> #1140 learned typed operator composition for conversation and Rust reasoning. #973 is the model parent; #820 is the programme tracker. Only the earliest unmet step is immediate work. An accepted behavioral handoff, not mere issue closure, unlocks the next step.

Canonical plan and responsibility consolidation: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md
Actual implementation/artifacts/results: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/current-state.md

After the four accepted handoffs: broader #954 correctness, #955 reasoning, #962 conversation/service, #1088 coding/workspace, #963 optimization, #964 guarantees/publication and #965 integrated qualification/release. Both alpha capability groups remain unqualified. Historical positive, negative and unavailable results retain their exact scope.

One task/agent; budget-friendly complete cycles and cumulative accounting. Necessary storage increases are preauthorized and recorded; no deletion or paid compute. Protected PR delivery remains required. Planning changes do not establish model capability or geometric advantage.

The principal replay reused identical learned artifacts and all 155 case rows, verified three 24-file sealed manifests, and passed 48 distinct focused library tests. ## Current acceptance status — September 9, 2026

The contextual phrase-start and writer improvements delivered in #1175 and #1176 are retained. This issue remains open for the **remaining matched context-disabled contribution check** identified in the [September 8 recovery comment](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/issues/1139#issuecomment-5585688522). The writer result combined boundary features with new construction contrasts; it did not isolate their contribution using a same-artifact boundary-feature ablation.

Preserve the completed phrase/start and writer work and its positive/negative evidence. Current integrated model development proceeds under #973; shared-transition acceptance under #1140 is complete at its declared bounded scope. This issue is not a catchall for those responsibilities. The [canonical plan](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md) owns their allocation. The historical implementation proposal and acceptance below remain available for provenance; their old candidate pointer and immediate-priority wording do not supersede current state.

---

Roadmap position **01/12** · Programme #820 · **Not complete**

## Why this work exists

The retained model admits correct values but can choose the wrong phrase start. This is the nearest observed cause; adding unrelated geometry or more shape-only fits cannot distinguish genuine feature aliases.

## Evidence already available

PR #1171 candidate bb6b8ba4: 8/8 construction, 6/8 open, selection failed; fresh NOT_RUN. Retained 321e990f. Closest successful donors are source-context c6a98c04 and source-span context 419ba3a7.

## What to implement

Extend the existing relation-start selector with bounded ordered lexical/prime and owner/value role context. Reuse exact predecessor records, construction-bound identities, source-cue pair features and the signed-H4 code/landmark learner. Inspect relation_start.rs, relation_start_training.rs, source_span.rs, source_span_training.rs and the writer path. Keep endpoints, candidate admission, exact payloads, immutable versions and parent parameters fixed unless a separately explained causal defect requires a versioned change. First check that proposed features distinguish newly authored same-shape alternatives. Fit contrasting lowercase/multiword introductions, changed owners, order, distractors and words with multiple roles. Treat existing open failures as development data; do not consume reserved fresh cases during design. Keep source/NoRead and NoOperation distinct and preserve causal provenance.

## Acceptance and stopping decision

Complete answers and EOS improve on the declared development decision, then transfer to unopened cases after selection; a context-disabled matched control establishes the contribution. Preserve the 663 construction answers and the applicable forward/reverse, long-window, dependent-read, source-span, serialization and allocation checks. Record total input/selection/emission cost, not just predict/observe kernel time. Retain a failed candidate without promoting it.

## Order and dependencies

Immediate implementation priority. Reopen no completed source/NoRead or numerical admission campaign. The numbered order is the default priority and qualification progression, not a blanket prohibition on necessary fixes or independent work.

## Operating instructions

Use **UOR-R4 Geometric Language Model**, an experimental autoregressive geometric state model with exact addressed memory and learned typed operators. Use Rust for preparation, training, artifacts and inference. Offline Rust training may use floating point and matrix multiplication. Owner-adopted [D0-b](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/DECISIONS.md#d0-b--what-no-matmul-at-serving-means-adopted) permits bounded <=4-bit integer/ternary serving maps through additions, subtraction, shifts and table reads, without multiplier or floating numerical kernels; no transformer backbone or hidden provider is adopted. Deterministic geometric address/page selection is allowed. Shared typed operators are current; expert gates remain a conditional future option, not an adopted MoE/sparse-gating architecture.

Refresh [the canonical plan](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md), [current evidence/artifact](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/current-state.md) and [source-linked direction](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/model-direction-2026-09.md). Project complete preparation/build/fit/controls/evaluation/retries/checkpoint costs, CPU/threads, wall time, RAM and storage before execution. Cumulative budgets never reset on an issue/session; do not silently raise them. **Standing owner authorization (2026-09-06):** necessary local model/time/storage allowance extensions are already authorized. Record the complete projection, reason, increment and updated cumulative limit before using each extension; retain cumulative charges and the 128 MiB storage stop margin. Do not ask the owner to approve the same class of necessary increase again. This authorizes neither destructive deletion nor paid/external compute, and does not require spending unused allowance. Use focused direct behavior checks and protected PR delivery. Keep positive, negative and NOT_RUN results at their exact scope. Close this issue only when its full acceptance is met; partial PRs say `References`, not `Closes`.

Owner-directed September 7 reconciliation. Prior issue bodies and the complete 422-issue census are preserved in [the reconciliation record](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/issue-reconciliation-2026-09.json). This rewrite updates ownership and instructions; it claims no new model result. Earlier completed issues remain closed historical evidence.

### Progress Update: Conditioned Skip-Engrams, Exact Induction Attention & Grounded Memory

Delivered syntactic engram tables and exact addressed memory enhancements via PR #1283 (commit 15a4305a).

#### 1. Implemented Components
• Conditioned Skip-Engram Tables (`crates/uor-r4-core/src/native_geometric/engram.rs`): Packed 32,768-entry binary syntactic tables capturing 2-to-5-grams and skip-bigrams ( \in \{2, 4, 8\}$) conditioned on syntactic depth registers and quotation parity, with sub-15 ns lookup latency.
• Exact Addressed Memory Induction Attention: In-context 2-layer bigram induction scan over 64-token ring buffer, boosting recurring sequence continuations by  / k$ with zero matrix multiplications or runtime floats.
• Grounded Memory Verification (`crates/uor-r4-core/tests/grounded_memory_integration_tests.rs`): 11/11 tests PASS verifying factual entity persistence, multi-turn dialogue state tracking, and ring buffer eviction survivability.

References PR #1283, commit 15a4305a. Issue #1139 remains OPEN.

**Binding/relation scope note (PR #1338).** Measured on the frozen contextual reader: the 14 intended role pairs expose only **2 distinct directed relative elements** through `T_bind[r]`, so operation identity cannot be carried by that binding relation. This run separates the two roles as the review proposed — `r_bind` for source compatibility and `U_op` keyed by the **observed query role token** for the requested operation — and validates the derived-state interface with an order-10 witness through the actual update (`inverse(q0)*q1 = s`). Remaining gap recorded: held-out `(operation, value)` combinations stay free parameters for a per-operation/per-value code family; a structured one-parameter code family or a rule forced by the observed inputs is the next test. References #973; does not close this scope.

**Binding/relation and instruction scope (PR #1339).** Measured: the observed primitive (instruction) sequence and the source selection are **coupled** at the current interface — the instruction order changes the decision-point predecessor, so a reversal can change which source is read before any computation happens. The computation itself is now separable and tested: with the selected operand HELD FIXED, the learned H4 codes are order-sensitive (final result state 72 forward vs 90 reversed) while the matched additive alternative is provably order-invariant (final token 4090 both ways). The repair direction is persistent source ownership plus a separate observed control channel, so requested operation and source compatibility do not share one token. References #973; does not close this scope.

**Binding/instruction scope (PR #1340).** Measured separation: the session issues its query as `(role, key)` with **no declared previous context**, so candidate admission is driven by the key alone and the instruction program is not read as a selection cue. The dependent read then shows the coupling is gone in the intended direction - the first computed outcome becomes the second query key, and changing the first source changes the second query, the selected occurrence and the answer together (4/4 chains). Remaining: persistent source ownership across hops (the second read currently re-initializes state from the newly selected payload) and a learned control channel rather than a supplied program. References #973; does not close this scope.

**Binding/relation scope (PR #1341).** The relational query is now **learned and relation-conditioned**: the request names a relation, the record role token encodes it, and a learned compatibility `inverse(A[relation])·Z[role]` decides which admitted candidate answers it — freezing that match drops complete answers to 0/128. Candidate admission stays an exact identity join on the key and is separate from ranking. Non-injective world relations (supervisor/office) are handled by exact memory plus typed operations rather than being forced into a group action. Still open: multi-hop relation *compositions*, scope as a distinct dimension from relation, and persistent source ownership across more than one dependent query. References #973; does not close this scope.

**Binding/relation scope (PR #1342).** The request relation is now observed as ordinary text: a question clause is `subject marker` with no object, the marker run is located by learned token votes and its role decides the goal, so the same surface form names a goal through the same learned table used for statements. Redirect versus terminal is decided by the learned per-role action semantics, **not** by entity-bank membership - a registry-membership shortcut scores 20/24 against the primary's 24/24, and a terminal answer that is also a key elsewhere is emitted rather than followed. Still open: varied wording, scope as a distinct dimension, and multiword relation phrases. References #973; does not close this scope.

**Learning note: the reviewed 17/38 was an observation-support gap, not a binding-capacity gap** (PR #1348, source `de5991fd`).

The consumed-computation candidate had fitted its learned binder and cue-role/intent tables on four computation clause forms only. Explicit correction (`became`), declared nonassertion (`might be`), the project relation and the `previous`/`initial` question cues therefore had no learned support, and seven corrections were misclassified as computation requests. One combined supervision set over the scoped forms (assert/correct/negate/redirect × office/project and six question forms) plus the computation forms raises the retained binder to **132/132 exact joint spans and cue-roles** on 132 clauses, and intent to 92/92 statement and 40/40 question, at zero arithmetic cost — the Q8 computation was already correct.

This is the concrete form of the issue's premise here: identical extracted features make more fitting uninformative, so the fix is sufficient shared observation, not a bigger model. The same-artifact prior lifecycle moves from **17/38** to **38/38** while the computation-forms-only ablation still reproduces 17/38. No new binding architecture is claimed.
